en: Only the worker is described. Its left mandible has an apical tooth equal to the first marginal tooth and a straight cutting edge between the marginal teeth, while the right mandible also has an apical tooth equal to the first marginal tooth, its second marginal tooth being small, blunt and close to the first. No soldier or alate is treated in the original account of this species.
worker: 工蚁左上颚端齿与第一缘齿相等，缘齿之间的切边平直；右上颚端齿亦等于第一缘齿，第二缘齿钝小，位置靠近第一缘齿。
